<p align="center"><strong>Chapter two - discover why the lanterns went dark.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key</small></p>


<p align="center">You choose the path deeper into the grounds. Each unlit lantern contains the same little brass star.</p>

<p align="center">The ghost calls from the attic: &quot;The nightkeeper used to guide people home. I have kept the tea warm, but I never learned to fix the light.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">You still have the brass key. For once, it feels like an invitation rather than a way out.</p>

<p align="center">Five repairs lie ahead: wake a moonseed, restore the pump, build a star lantern, find the sky bearing and rekindle the beacon.</p>
